one_liner: LinkedIn Ads (Marketing/Advertising API) is a broad REST API with 3-legged OAuth2; apps are created self-serve but the Advertising API product requires LinkedIn approval, with the Development tier limited to editing 5 ad accounts.
auth_notes: All Marketing API permissions are 3-legged (authorization code); 2-legged/client-credentials is not available for marketing use cases.
access_notes: Advertising API is a vetted product: apply from the app's Product tab in the Developer Portal. Development tier allows edits on up to 5 ad accounts; Standard tier needs a separate upgrade application, and LinkedIn may decline at its discretion. Free-of-charge claim comes from a third-party source and was not verified on the vendor pages.
blocker_notes: The Advertising API product requires LinkedIn approval; Standard tier requires a further upgrade for managing many accounts. Development tier is enough to build and test (5 editable ad accounts).
